node.statement: Put P_R=w(e_R)=P_U+P_V for R=U union V. Because epsilon_A<=t, A satisfies the extended t-C*-bounds. Since w is an extended t-inclusion and e_U,e_V,e_R are projections, P_U,P_V,P_R are t-projections. The lower inclusion bound and t<1 make P_R nonvanishing. From e_Ue_R=e_Re_U=e_U and e_Ve_R=e_Re_V=e_V, the multiplicative-defect bound gives all four left/right subordination errors of P_U,P_V to P_R at most t. By def-maincb-partition-state and the compressed-corner notation, A_R=S^A_{P_R}, P_U^R=Co^A_{P_R}(P_U), and P_V^R=Co^A_{P_R}(P_V).
